name: odin-sign-up-form
description: Stylized sign-up form for The Odin Project, built with HTML and CSS only. Practices form markup, `:user-valid`, `:user-invalid` and `:focus` pseudo-classes, custom fonts, and a semi-transparent overlay on a full-height background image.

paragraphs: A stylized sign-up form built for The Odin Project to practice intermediate HTML and CSS. The project focuses on building structured forms and utilizing CSS pseudo-classes to provide real-time visual feedback for user validation and active input states. It also implements custom fonts and transparent background overlays to ensure text readability against a large background image.
